title: Inverse-variance weighting of two studies
caption: Weights 1/SE² are 1 and 1/4. The pooled effect is (1 × 2 + 0.25 × 4)/1.25 = 2.4, nearer the more precise first study, with SE = 1/√1.25 ≈ 0.894.
alt: A number line from 1 to 5 with the studies at 2 and 4 and the pooled estimate 2.4 close to 2.
description: The study with SE 1 gets weight 1; the one with SE 2 gets weight 1/4.
